item.title: Don Lugo Drama Club Stages Spring One-Act Festival
item.dc:creator: Maya Reyes
item.description: The Don Lugo High School Drama Club closed out the year with a festival of student-directed one-act plays in the Conejo Theater on Tuesday night, drawing a full house of families and classmates.
item.content:encoded:
The Don Lugo High School Drama Club closed out the year with a festival of student-directed one-act plays in the Conejo Theater on Tuesday night, drawing a full house of families and classmates. Five one-acts were staged back to back, each written and directed entirely by students in the advanced drama seminar.

Senior director Maya Reyes said the format gave underclassmen their first chance to direct a full cast. "It's a lot of pressure, but it's the best way to learn," she said.

item.title: Boys Basketball Opens Season With Win Over Ayala
item.dc:creator: Diego Alvarez
item.content:encoded:
The Don Lugo Conquistadors opened their league season with a 58-49 win over Ayala at home Friday night, led by a 21-point performance from junior guard Marcus Webb.

Head coach Terry Osborne credited the team's defense in the fourth quarter for pulling away from a tied game at the start of the period.
